description: Kerala's 2026-27 budget allocates funds for key projects in Kochi, including an AI city and Cochin Cancer Centre.
body_lead: A proposal for developing an integrated public transport system, an artificial intelligence city, Cochin Cancer Research Centre, Kochi technology innovation zone, and the Kochi-Muziris heritage project were among the major Kochi-based projects mentioned in the State Budget presented on Thursday (January 29).
